# Triggers

<!-- Generated by `dotnet tools/AlbocariusCompanions.Cli/bin/.../AlbocariusCompanions.Cli.dll docs triggers docs/TRIGGERS.md` from the
     trigger registry (src/AlbocariusCompanions.Core/Triggers). Do not edit by hand. -->

A conversation or a slot-free line with a `trigger` is started by the game (see docs/SCHEMA.md, "Triggers"). This page
lists every trigger: 30 in total, grouped by category, with the subjects it accepts, its payload
fields (usable in `where` and in `event.<field>` conditions) and an example.

## Subjects

| Subject | Matches when a subject field is … |
|---|---|
| `self` | this companion (a hero, or a party it leads) |
| `player` | the player (hero), the player's party, clan or kingdom |
| `playerParty` | anyone in the player's party, or the player's party |
| `playerClan` | a member of the player's clan, a party/settlement of the player's clan, the player's kingdom |
| `companion:<id>` | that mod companion |
| `hero:<stringId>` | that hero (or a party it leads) |
| `settlement:<stringId>` | that settlement |
| `any` | always |

A trigger with several subject fields matches when any of them matches. World-wide triggers never default to `any`.

## Field kinds

Entity fields compare by id (`"victim": "lord_1_1"`) or by property (`"victim.culture": "vlandia"`). Properties:

| Kind | Properties |
|---|---|
| Hero | `id`, `name`, `isPlayer`, `inPlayerParty`, `inPlayerClan`, `companion`, `heroId`, `culture`, `clan`, `kingdom`, `occupation`, `isCompanion`, `isAlive` |
| Party | `id`, `name`, `isPlayer`, `inPlayerParty`, `inPlayerClan`, `companion`, `heroId`, `leader`, `clan`, `kingdom`, `isMainParty` |
| Settlement | `id`, `name`, `isPlayer`, `inPlayerParty`, `inPlayerClan`, `companion`, `heroId`, `culture`, `kind`, `ownerClan`, `kingdom` |
| Clan | `id`, `name`, `isPlayer`, `inPlayerParty`, `inPlayerClan`, `companion`, `heroId`, `culture`, `kingdom`, `leader` |
| Kingdom | `id`, `name`, `isPlayer`, `inPlayerParty`, `inPlayerClan`, `companion`, `heroId`, `culture`, `leader` |
| Faction | `id`, `name`, `isPlayer`, `inPlayerParty`, `inPlayerClan`, `companion`, `heroId`, `culture`, `leader`, `kingdom`, `isKingdom` |
| Item | `id`, `name`, `isPlayer`, `inPlayerParty`, `inPlayerClan`, `companion`, `heroId`, `type` |

Other kinds: Int (whole number), Number (decimal), Bool (`true`/`false`), Text (game ids and enum names as the game writes them).

## Delivery limits

- A companion interrupts (conversation or inquiry) at most once every 3 in-game days.
- At most 1 interruption(s) per in-game day, all companions together.
- At most 3 notifications per in-game day, counted apart from interruptions.
- Defaults: `chance` 1, `expiresAfterHours` 24, `cooldownDays` 0.
- Inquiries with up to 2 options use the standard pop-up, more use the multi-choice pop-up.
- Items fired inside a battle or scene ("in mission") wait for the map.

## Common triggers

- [`daily`](#daily) — Once per in-game day; combine with `chance` for random comments.
- [`heroCaptured`](#herocaptured) — A hero was taken prisoner anywhere in the world (by the player or by anyone else).
- [`heroKilled`](#herokilled) — A hero died (battle, execution, old age, …).
- [`heroReleased`](#heroreleased) — A captive hero was set free (`detail` says how); a freed player companion goes fugitive at the same moment.
- [`heroWounded`](#herowounded) — A hero's health dropped into the wounded state (companion knocked out in a fight; there is no heal event).
- [`nearSettlement`](#nearsettlement) — The player's party came within `radius` of a settlement; fires again only after it went beyond `rearmRadius`.
- [`playerBattleEnded`](#playerbattleended) — A battle the player fought in ended (winner known; casualties and loot not yet counted).
- [`roleEnded`](#roleended) — A companion left a role.
- [`roleStarted`](#rolestarted) — A companion took a role (governor, party leader, …).
- [`varCrossed`](#varcrossed) — One of this companion's variables crossed `value` in `direction` (up: from below to at-or-above; down: from at-or-above to below).
- [`villageLooted`](#villagelooted) — A village raid finished and the village is now looted.

## Category: battle

### battleStarted

A single battle on an engagement started on the map; sides and place known, no outcome yet.

- Source: `CampaignEvents.BattleStarted`
- Subjects: `self`, `player`, `playerParty`, `playerClan`, `companion:<id>`, `hero:<id>`, `settlement:<id>`, `any`; default `playerClan` (matched on `attacker`, `defender`, `settlement`)

| Field | Kind | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `attacker` | Party | the attacking party |
| `defender` | Party | the defending party |
| `settlement` | Settlement | the settlement the battle is fought for; empty in the open field |

```json
"trigger": { "on": "battleStarted", "subject": "playerClan", "where": { "settlement.culture": "vlandia" } }
```

### heroHitInCombat

A hero landed one blow during a battle — fires for every hero blow in every battle (very chatty; gate on `fatal`).

- Source: `CampaignEvents.OnHeroCombatHitEvent` — fires in a battle or scene (in mission)
- Subjects: `self`, `player`, `playerParty`, `playerClan`, `companion:<id>`, `hero:<id>`, `any`; default `playerClan` (matched on `victim`, `attacker`, `attackerParty`)

| Field | Kind | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `attacker` | Hero | the hero who landed the blow |
| `victim` | Hero | the hero hit; empty when a common troop took the blow |
| `attackerParty` | Party | the side the attacker fights on |
| `fatal` | Bool | the blow was lethal |
| `xp` | Int | the experience the game awarded for the blow |

```json
"trigger": { "on": "heroHitInCombat", "subject": "playerClan", "where": { "attacker.culture": "vlandia" } }
```

### heroWounded

A hero's health dropped into the wounded state (companion knocked out in a fight; there is no heal event).

- Source: `CampaignEvents.HeroWounded` — fires in a battle or scene (in mission)
- Subjects: `self`, `player`, `playerParty`, `playerClan`, `companion:<id>`, `hero:<id>`, `any`; default `playerClan` (matched on `hero`)

| Field | Kind | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `hero` | Hero | the hero who became wounded |

```json
"trigger": { "on": "heroWounded", "subject": "playerClan", "where": { "hero.culture": "vlandia" } }
```

### mapEventEnded

- Source: `CampaignEvents.MapEventEnded`
- Subjects: `settlement:<id>`, `playerClan`, `self`, `player`, `playerParty`, `companion:<id>`, `hero:<id>`, `any`; default `playerClan` (matched on `settlement`, `attacker`, `defender`)

| Field | Kind | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `settlement` | Settlement | the settlement fought at or over; empty in the open field |
| `attacker` | Party | leading party of the attacking side |
| `defender` | Party | leading party of the defending side |
| `winner` | Text | attacker \| defender \| none |
| `playerInvolved` | Bool | the player's party fought in it |

### crimeRatingChanged

The player's crime rating with a faction changed (`delta` > 0 = a new crime; < 0 = daily decay, a fine or peace).

```json

```

## Category: heroes

### heroAboutToBeKilled

A hero is about to be killed; fires before heroKilled, while their live party and prison state can still be read.

- Source: `CampaignEvents.BeforeHeroKilledEvent`
- Subjects: `self`, `player`, `playerParty`, `playerClan`, `companion:<id>`, `hero:<id>`, `any`; default `playerClan` (matched on `victim`)

| Field | Kind | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `victim` | Hero | the hero about to die |
| `killer` | Hero | who is killing them; empty for natural deaths |
| `detail` | Text | the game's KillCharacterActionDetail (same values as in heroKilled) |

```json
"trigger": { "on": "heroAboutToBeKilled", "subject": "playerClan", "where": { "victim.culture": "vlandia" } }
```

## Category: polling

### daily

Once per in-game day; combine with `chance` for random comments.

- Source: polling (internal tick)
- Subjects: `any`; default `any`

```json
"trigger": { "on": "daily" }
```

### nearSettlement

The player's party came within `radius` of a settlement; fires again only after it went beyond `rearmRadius`.

- Source: polling (internal tick)
- Subjects: `any`; default `any`

| Field | Kind | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `settlement` | Settlement | the settlement approached |

| Parameter | Kind | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `settlement` | Text | yes | settlement string id, e.g. town_V1 |
| `radius` | Number | yes | fire distance in map units (> 0) |
| `rearmRadius` | Number | yes | re-arm distance in map units (> radius) |

```json
"trigger": { "on": "nearSettlement", "where": { "settlement.culture": "vlandia" }, "params": { "settlement": "town_V1", "radius": 5, "rearmRadius": 8 } }
```

A companion left a role.

- Source: polling (internal tick)
- Subjects: `self`, `player`, `playerParty`, `playerClan`, `companion:<id>`, `hero:<id>`, `any`; default `self` (matched on `companion`)

| Field | Kind | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `companion` | Hero | the companion |
| `role` | Text | governor \| partyLeader \| caravanLeader \| alleyLeader \| questAlternative |

| Parameter | Kind | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `role` | Text | yes | governor \| partyLeader \| caravanLeader \| alleyLeader \| questAlternative |

```json
"trigger": { "on": "roleEnded", "subject": "self", "where": { "companion.culture": "vlandia" }, "params": { "role": "governor" } }
```

### roleStarted

A companion took a role (governor, party leader, …).

- Source: polling (internal tick)
- Subjects: `self`, `player`, `playerParty`, `playerClan`, `companion:<id>`, `hero:<id>`, `any`; default `self` (matched on `companion`)

| Field | Kind | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `companion` | Hero | the companion |
| `role` | Text | governor \| partyLeader \| caravanLeader \| alleyLeader \| questAlternative |

| Parameter | Kind | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `role` | Text | yes | governor \| partyLeader \| caravanLeader \| alleyLeader \| questAlternative |

### varCrossed

One of this companion's variables crossed `value` in `direction` (up: from below to at-or-above; down: from at-or-above to below).

- Source: polling (internal tick)
- Subjects: `any`; default `any`

| Field | Kind | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `var` | Text | the variable name |
| `value` | Int | the variable's new value |

| Parameter | Kind | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `var` | Text | yes | an int variable of this companion, e.g. mood |
| `value` | Int | yes | the threshold |
| `direction` | Text | yes | up \| down |

```json
"trigger": { "on": "varCrossed", "params": { "var": "mood", "value": 10, "direction": "up" } }
```

## Category: prisoners

### heroCaptured

A hero was taken prisoner anywhere in the world (by the player or by anyone else).

- Source: `CampaignEvents.HeroPrisonerTaken`
- Subjects: `self`, `player`, `playerParty`, `playerClan`, `companion:<id>`, `hero:<id>`, `any`; default `playerClan` (matched on `prisoner`, `captor`)

| Field | Kind | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `prisoner` | Hero | the hero taken captive |
| `captor` | Party | the party that took them |

```json
"trigger": { "on": "heroCaptured", "subject": "playerClan", "where": { "prisoner.culture": "vlandia" } }
```

### heroReleased

A captive hero was set free (`detail` says how); a freed player companion goes fugitive at the same moment.

- Source: `CampaignEvents.HeroPrisonerReleased`
- Subjects: `self`, `player`, `playerParty`, `playerClan`, `companion:<id>`, `hero:<id>`, `any`; default `playerClan` (matched on `prisoner`, `formerCaptor`, `formerCaptorFaction`)

| Field | Kind | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `prisoner` | Hero | the released hero |
| `formerCaptor` | Party | the party that was holding them |
| `formerCaptorFaction` | Faction | the faction that was holding them |
| `detail` | Text | the game's EndCaptivityDetail: Ransom, ReleasedAfterPeace, ReleasedAfterBattle, ReleasedAfterEscape, ReleasedByChoice, Death, ReleasedByCompensation |

```json
"trigger": { "on": "heroReleased", "subject": "playerClan", "where": { "prisoner.culture": "vlandia" } }
```

### prisonersChangedInSettlement

The prisoners of a settlement's dungeon changed; the event does not say who moved them.

- Source: `CampaignEvents.PrisonersChangeInSettlement`
- Subjects: `settlement:<id>`, `playerClan`, `self`, `player`, `playerParty`, `companion:<id>`, `hero:<id>`, `any`; default `playerClan` (matched on `settlement`, `prisoner`)

| Field | Kind | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `settlement` | Settlement | the settlement whose dungeon changed |
| `prisoner` | Hero | the single hero moved; empty when a whole prison roster moved |
| `takenFromDungeon` | Bool | true: prisoners left the dungeon; false: prisoners were added |

```json
"trigger": { "on": "prisonersChangedInSettlement", "subject": "playerClan", "where": { "settlement.culture": "vlandia" } }
```

|---|---|---|
| `captive` | Hero | the captive the ransom offer concerned |

```json

```
